command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=2319dcde91284c959837637d055e056e15137c70
REMOTE=https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git
STERN="$HOME/.claude/star/stern.py"
DEST="$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts"
VOICE=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
CLIENT=frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service
status_json="$(python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status)"
aktiv="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(sys.stdin).get("aktiv"))).lower())')"
if [ "$aktiv" != false ]; then echo 'REFUSED: live voice conversation active' >&2; exit 20; fi
echo 'PRECONDITION_VOICE_QUIESCENT=1'
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-final.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$tmp" init -q
git -C "$tmp" remote add origin "$REMOTE"
git -C "$tmp" fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$EXPECTED"
git -C "$tmp" checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
actual="$(git -C "$tmp" rev-parse HEAD)"
[ "$actual" = "$EXPECTED" ] || { echo "REFUSED: fetched $actual expected $EXPECTED" >&2; exit 21; }
echo "SOURCE_COMMIT=$actual"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_voice777_multiarm_integration.py"
echo 'SOURCE_TESTS_PASS=1'
bash "$tmp/scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh"
files='omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py'
for f in $files; do cmp -s "$tmp/scripts/$f" "$DEST/$f" || { echo "FAIL: installed mismatch $f" >&2; exit 22; }; done
echo 'INSTALL_READBACK_PASS=1'
status_json="$(python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status)"
aktiv="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(sys.stdin).get("aktiv"))).lower())')"
if [ "$aktiv" != false ]; then echo 'REFUSED: voice became active before cutover' >&2; exit 23; fi
old_client="$(systemctl --user show "$CLIENT" -p MainPID --value)"
old_voice="$(systemctl --user show "$VOICE" -p MainPID --value)"
systemctl --user restart "$CLIENT"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$CLIENT" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] && break; sleep 1; done
[ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$CLIENT" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] || exit 24
systemctl --user restart "$VOICE"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$VOICE" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] && break; sleep 1; done
[ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$VOICE" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] || exit 25
new_client="$(systemctl --user show "$CLIENT" -p MainPID --value)"
new_voice="$(systemctl --user show "$VOICE" -p MainPID --value)"
printf 'CLIENT_PID=%s->%s\nVOICE_PID=%s->%s\n' "$old_client" "$new_client" "$old_voice" "$new_voice"
client_cmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$new_client/cmdline")"
voice_cmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$new_voice/cmdline")"
printf 'CLIENT_CMD=%s\nVOICE_CMD=%s\n' "$client_cmd" "$voice_cmd"
case "$client_cmd" in *voice_host_777_live_client.py*) ;; *) echo 'FAIL: client wrapper not live' >&2; exit 26;; esac
case "$voice_cmd" in *voice_777_runtime.py*) ;; *) echo 'FAIL: voice wrapper not live' >&2; exit 27;; esac
echo '=== INSTALLED SHA256 ==='
for f in $files; do sha256sum "$DEST/$f"; done
echo '=== SERVICES ==='
systemctl --user show "$CLIENT" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p Result -p NRestarts --no-pager
systemctl --user show "$VOICE" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p Result -p NRestarts --no-pager
echo '=== VOICE STATUS ==='
python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status
echo "OMEGA_CONVERGED_COMMIT=$EXPECTED"
echo OMEGA_FINAL_ASSEMBLY_PASS=1
